findings.title: Frontend changes in scope despite spec saying 'Frontend is out of scope'
findings.spec_requirement: Spec intro: 'Frontend is out of scope.'
findings.evidence: Diff modifies BulkGenerateAiSummariesConfirmModal.tsx (93 lines changed), JobStageMenu.tsx (35 lines changed), useBulkGenerateAiSummaries.ts (8 lines changed). These change the bulk generate UI from passing raw job_application_ids to using job_id + hiring_stage_id + included/excluded pattern.
findings.recommendation: These changes accompany the backend BulkAiJobApplicationSummariesController refactor (analog structural fix from Known Failure Pattern #14). The frontend must match the backend API contract change. However, the spec explicitly says frontend is out of scope. Classify as HIGH per Layer 1 rules: every change must trace to a spec requirement.
findings.severity_rationale: The spec says frontend is out of scope. The diff includes frontend changes. This is a spec-implementation mismatch. However, these changes are mechanically coupled to the backend API change (the old frontend API contract no longer works). The real question is whether the bulk controller refactor should have been in the spec.

findings.title: BulkAiJobApplicationSummariesController refactored to analog pattern (not in spec)
findings.spec_requirement: No spec section covers bulk controller API changes
findings.evidence: Diff adds resolve_job_application_ids method, changes params from job_application_ids[] to job_id + hiring_stage_id + included_job_application_ids[] + excluded_job_application_ids[]. This is a pre-existing analog deviation fix from Known Failure Pattern #14.
findings.recommendation: This was a pre-work fix identified before implementation. It should have been included in the spec as a prerequisite change. The change itself is correct (matches the bulk move/bulk message analog pattern), but it is not spec'd.

findings.title: GenerateAiJobApplicationSummaryJob retry/exhaustion block significantly modified
findings.spec_requirement: Spec section 3 mentions updating status enum references in the job. Spec does not mention adding an exhaustion block, changing error handling behavior, or removing broadcast on retry.
findings.evidence: Diff adds exhaustion block (lines 4-10 of new code), removes broadcast on CustomErrorAiSummary retry (removed line: broadcast_completion... if textract_result && requesting_organization_user_id), adds ai_summary failed status setting + broadcast in StandardError rescue, adds exhaustion status setting to failed. These are behavioral changes beyond simple enum reference updates.
findings.recommendation: The exhaustion block addition follows the analog pattern (Known Failure Pattern #14 - ExtractJobCriteriaJob and GetResumeTextFromTextractJob both have exhaustion blocks). The broadcast removal on retry is a behavioral change: previously, each retry attempt would broadcast; now only exhaustion/StandardError does. This changes user-visible behavior (fewer error toasts during retries, toast only on final failure). This is a significant behavioral change not covered by the spec.

findings.title: ExtractCriteria sets failed status on CustomErrorAiSummary rescue instead of retrying
findings.spec_requirement: Spec Section 4: 'Error handling: same pattern as AiJobApplicationAction::Summary::Generate'. Summary::Generate sets retrying on CustomErrorAiSummary.
findings.evidence: In extract_criteria.rb, the rescue CustomErrorAiSummary block sets status: :failed (line 971: @ai_job_criteria&.update_columns(status: :failed, error_message: e&.message)). But AiJobCriteria has no retrying status. The spec says 'same pattern as Summary::Generate'. Summary::Generate sets retrying on CustomErrorAiSummary. However, AiJobCriteria's enum only has pending/in_progress/succeeded/failed (no retrying), so failed is the only option.
findings.recommendation: The spec says to follow Summary::Generate's error handling pattern. Summary::Generate sets retrying on CustomErrorAiSummary and re-raises for the job to retry. ExtractCriteria sets failed and re-raises. Since AiJobCriteria has no retrying status, the job will retry but find a failed record. ExtractJobCriteriaJob loads by ID and calls extract, which will hit the update_columns(status: :in_progress) early in the extract method, effectively resetting from failed. The behavior is functionally correct but deviates from the spec's stated pattern. The spec could be interpreted as 'adapt the pattern to the model's enum', but the deviation should be noted.
